card.name: Linking words in science and policy prose
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "and", "of", "on" and "with", and some adjectives like "significant", in formal science, research or policy sentences. They sit mid-clause, before a verb or noun about improving, treating or protecting something.

modes.label: Linking words in lists and phrases
modes.description: "and", "of", "on" or "with" joining items or leading into a phrase in a research or policy sentence.
modes.example: NIAID conducts and funds research to improve our ability to prevent, diagnose,<< and>> treat anthrax.

modes.label: Formal adjectives before a key noun
modes.description: Adjectives or adverbs like "significant", "fundamental" or "scientific" that come just before an important noun or verb.
